description: CANDIDATE-DEFINED development benchmark. Sequential greedy (temperature 0, top_k 1) streamed chat completions; per-repetition TTFT median and Etalon FTGR via benchmarks.metrics; correctness gates: all requests succeed, finish_reason valid, complete output, streamed-chunk count vs usage.completion_tokens, greedy self-consistency, golden-output match against the baseline. Not an official grade.

prompts.prompt: What is the capital of France? Answer in one sentence.
What is 12 plus 30? Reply with just the number.
Write a two-line poem about rain.
Explain in two sentences why the sky is blue.
Name four planets of the solar system, comma separated.

extra_request_fields_note: llama.cpp-specific: disables server-side prompt-cache reuse so every request pays full prefill (stable TTFT). Remove for engines that reject unknown fields (set to {} for LLMD).
